recommended_followups.title: Railway deploy does NOT run DB migrations; schema-bearing engagements need a manual prod migrate step
recommended_followups.why: Confirmed at MR-CAL-6B/6C-LIVE: migration 0002 (locked_decisions) was absent on prod after deploy (start command launches the server only). Resolved by running the CREATE TABLE in the TiDB SQL editor. Going forward, any engagement adding/altering tables must apply the migration to prod TiDB out-of-band (TiDB SQL editor or a Railway one-off `pnpm db:migrate`) as part of its live verification.
